Ritika Malhotra

**Professional Experience / Work History**  
At InnovateTech, I spearheaded the transition from monolithic to microservices architecture, reducing deployment latency by 40% through the orchestration of Kubernetes clusters and ArgoCD pipelines. My work on automating infrastructure provisioning with Terraform slashed manual setup time by 65%, enabling the team to scale rapidly during a product launch. I also led the integration of Prometheus and Grafana for real-time monitoring, which cut incident resolution time by 30% by providing actionable insights into system performance.  

Prior to that, as a Senior DevOps Engineer at CloudLeap Solutions, I architected a CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions and Jenkins, achieving 99.95% deployment reliability. My role in designing a multi-region AWS infrastructure with auto-scaling and load balancing ensured zero downtime during peak traffic periods, supporting a 200% increase in user base. I also optimized Linux server configurations, reducing resource utilization by 25% and improving overall system stability.  

In my early career at TechNova Inc., I developed a custom monitoring solution combining Nagios and Grafana, which alerted teams to critical issues 15 minutes faster than previous systems. This initiative reduced unplanned outages by 35% and became a foundational component of the company’s SRE practices.  

**Projects / Side Projects**  
At InnovateTech, I led the creation of a dynamic configuration management system using Python and Terraform, allowing teams to deploy environment-specific settings with minimal friction. This project eliminated configuration errors in 80% of deployment cycles and was adopted across three product lines.  

As a side project, I built a cloud cost optimization tool using AWS Lambda and Prometheus, which identified underutilized resources and saved the company $120K annually. The tool’s dashboard, developed with Grafana, became an internal standard for budget tracking.  

I also collaborated with a fintech startup to design a Kubernetes-based platform for real-time data processing, leveraging ArgoCD for seamless CI/CD integration. The platform handled 500K transactions per second, demonstrating robust scalability and fault tolerance.  

**Technical Skills / Technologies**  
- **AWS**: Owned the design of a multi-region architecture at CloudLeap, reducing latency by 50% and achieving 99.99% SLA compliance. Implemented auto-scaling groups and DynamoDB for high-throughput applications, supporting 10x traffic growth.  
- **ArgoCD**: Built a GitOps pipeline for InnovateTech, automating deployments across 12 environments with zero manual intervention. Reduced deployment errors by 70% through declarative configuration management.  
- **CI/CD Pipelines**: Developed a GitHub Actions-based workflow at CloudLeap, integrating Jenkins for parallel testing, which cut deployment cycles from 45 minutes to 12 minutes.  
- **Kubernetes**: Optimized cluster resource allocation at InnovateTech, improving pod density by 40% and reducing node costs by 30%. Implemented automated rollback mechanisms using Prometheus alerts.  
- **Python**: Automated infrastructure audits and compliance checks at TechNova, identifying 200+ security vulnerabilities in production systems.  
- **Linux Administration**: Redesigned server monitoring at CloudLeap, implementing systemd units and cron jobs to reduce incident response time by 25%.  
- **Terraform**: Streamlined infrastructure provisioning at InnovateTech, eliminating 500+ manual commands and ensuring reproducible environments across teams.  
- **Prometheus/Grafana**: Built dashboards for real-time metrics at CloudLeap, enabling proactive troubleshooting and reducing mean time to resolution by 30%.  
- **Jenkins**: Integrated with GitHub Actions to create a scalable CI/CD pipeline at CloudLeap, supporting 50+ microservices with parallel test execution.
